entries.title: The app stays responsive while Claude crewmates on another computer take many steps
entries.body: When Claude crewmates ran long turns on another of your computers, the app could freeze for seconds at a time, even while you typed. It now checks those crewmates' finished steps without slowing down, however many steps a turn takes.
entries.noPicture: This fixes a freeze while crewmates work, which a still picture cannot show.
